full_prompt_en: A square concept-art illustration centers on an improbable industrial structure elevated above a long low platform. The main body is a dense stack of boxy red, gray, and cream compartments, like pieces of a small ship or building assembled vertically. Rust-red panels occupy much of the left face, while an off-white central wall and dark protruding platforms make the right side more irregular. Circular porthole-like openings, narrow windows, grilles, railings, exposed cables, and pipes break up the surfaces. At the top, antennas and thin masts rise into a clear saturated blue sky, with a small ochre dish standing out near the highest part. The entire bulky upper section balances on dark articulated metal supports, leaving an open gap between its lower edge and the platform beneath. A round mechanical housing is visible near the right leg. Along the bottom of the frame, a thin dock-like strip carries tiny utility structures, poles, and dishes; its horizontal line emphasizes the extraordinary height and weight above it. Loose wires drape from the left side of the structure to distant posts, adding finer arcs across the open blue. The image is viewed from a low, fairly straight angle, so the stacked mass rises dramatically without extreme perspective distortion. Broad painted color blocks define the main volume, while scratchy black linework and small bright edge accents reveal wear and construction. Warm corroded reds contrast strongly with cobalt sky. The sky is largely empty, giving the dense machine a clear silhouette. No legible text can be read on the panels. The result feels like a weathered mobile outpost, both sturdy and precariously assembled.
full_prompt_zh: 方形概念艺术插画把一座不可思议的工业结构置于长而低的平台上方。主体由一层层红、灰、米白的盒状舱室紧密堆成，像把小船或建筑的部件竖向组装起来。锈红面板占据左侧大部，米白色中央墙面及突出的深色平台让右侧更加不规则。圆形舷窗状开口、窄窗、格栅、栏杆、外露电缆和管线打破平面。顶部，天线和细桅杆伸入饱和蓝天，一只小赭黄圆盘在高处特别显眼。整个笨重上层由深色关节金属支脚托起，让其底缘与下方平台之间留出明显空隙。右侧支脚旁可见圆形机械壳体。画面底端，一条薄薄的码头状横带承载微小设备、杆柱和圆盘；这条水平线强调上方结构惊人的高度与重量。松弛电线从结构左侧牵向远处杆柱，在空旷蓝色里添上更细的弧线。视角较低且大致平直，所以层叠体块显得高耸，却没有极端透视扭曲。宽阔绘画色块建立主体体积，刮擦般的黑色线条和细小受光边缘呈现磨损与构造。温暖锈红与钴蓝天空形成强烈对照。天空大面积留空，让密集机器有清晰轮廓。面板上没有可辨认文字。整体像一座饱经风化的移动哨站，既坚固又带着拼装的险峻感。
style_prompt_en: Industrial concept painting sets dense, layered mechanical geometry against an expansive saturated blue field. Rust red, oxidized gray, cream, and dark steel masses stack into an irregular vertical silhouette above a thin horizontal base. Fine antennas, hanging cables, and railing lines extend beyond the larger painted blocks, giving the image a delicate secondary rhythm. Scraped pigment, small edge highlights, visible seams, and ink-dark construction marks make the surfaces feel weathered and assembled. A low viewpoint emphasizes height while keeping the main shapes readable. Strong warm-cool contrast and generous empty space prevent the complex center from becoming visually flat. The mood is speculative, rugged, and monumental.
style_prompt_zh: 工业概念绘画把密集分层的机械几何体置于宽阔饱和蓝色场域前。锈红、氧化灰、米白和深钢色块在细长水平底座上堆成不规则竖向轮廓。细天线、垂落电缆和栏杆线延出大块绘画色面，形成轻巧的次要节奏。刮擦颜料、细小边缘亮点、可见接缝与墨黑构造痕迹让表面显得风化且由部件组装。较低视点强调高度，同时保持主要形体可读。强烈冷暖对照和充足留白使复杂中心不至于视觉上扁平。气氛充满推想，粗犷而宏大。
theme_en: A rust-red mechanical tower standing on articulated legs against blue sky
theme_zh: 锈红色机械高塔以关节支脚立于蓝天前
name: Ian McQue
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
